descriptions.zh: 我们截获了一条发往[CommSpreader.GetName]的消息，我们发现他们和另一个我们尚未发现的帝国建立了定期联系。我们追踪这条消息，与这位星系中的神秘角色建立了通讯线路。
descriptions.en: By intercepting a message sent to the [CommSpreader.GetName], we have learned that they are in regular contact with another spacefaring empire that we ourselves have no contact with. By tracing this message to its source, we have been able to establish our own line of communications with this previously unknown actor on the galactic stage.

descriptions.zh: 我们从一个太空深处的未知帝国那里收到了一份公报，他们自称§H[From.GetName]§!。他们还声称，他们从我们与另一个帝国的通讯中发现了我们的存在。
descriptions.en: We have received a communiqué from a previously unknown spacefaring empire that call themselves the §H[From.GetName]§!. They claim to have learned of our existence by listening in on the communications of another empire we are in contact with.
